description: The deepest dungeon — a nightmare realm where all the world's horrors converge. Every type of enemy dwells here, and at the bottom waits something ancient and unknowable. Only the strongest parties dare enter.

environment.lighting: shifting unreality, purple-black void with floating debris

encounter_waves.name: The Threshold
encounter_waves.description: Reality warps. The ground shifts beneath your feet as twisted creatures materialize.

encounter_waves.name: Echoes of the Wild
encounter_waves.description: Twisted beasts from a corrupted version of the Thornwood attack from all sides.

encounter_waves.name: Fallen Legion
encounter_waves.description: Dark knights and cultists who sought power in the Abyss — and found it, at a cost.

encounter_waves.name: Infernal Remnants
encounter_waves.description: Demons banished to the Abyss prowl these halls, hungrier than ever.

encounter_waves.name: Elemental Chaos
encounter_waves.description: The elements themselves have gone mad in this place. Warped elementals clash and attack everything.

encounter_waves.name: The Gauntlet
encounter_waves.description: Wave after wave of the Abyss's denizens. They just keep coming.

encounter_waves.name: The Void Sentinels
encounter_waves.description: The final guardians of the Abyss — twisted amalgamations of every horror you've faced.

boss_override.name: Neth'arak the Void
boss_override.title: Devourer of Worlds
boss_override.description: An entity from beyond reality itself. It has no form — only hunger. It wears the shapes of your worst fears.

phases.name: The Shape of Fear
phases.description: Neth'arak takes the form of a massive shadow, lashing out with tendrils of void energy.

abilities.name: Summon Nightmare
abilities.description: Summons a random elite enemy from any theme.

phases.name: The Hungry Dark
phases.description: Neth'arak expands, filling the arena with darkness. Every attack drains life.
phases.transition_text: The void SURGES. Neth'arak's form expands until it fills your entire vision. "I AM THE DARK BETWEEN STARS. I AM THE HUNGER THAT CONSUMES."

abilities.name: Void Prison
abilities.description: Traps one party member in a void prison. Immobilized and taking dark damage.

phases.name: Annihilation
phases.description: Neth'arak begins to collapse reality itself. The arena crumbles into the void.
phases.transition_text: Reality SHATTERS. The floor, the walls, the ceiling — all falling into infinite darkness. Only you and the entity remain, suspended in nothing.

mechanic.description: Reality is collapsing. The party takes escalating void damage each turn. Kill Neth'arak before turn 8 or be consumed.

abilities.name: Unmake
abilities.description: Attempts to erase a party member from existence. Massive single-target dark damage.

boss.pre_battle_text: There is no chamber. There is no floor. There is only darkness — and in that darkness, something watches. Something vast. Something that has always been waiting for you.
boss.intro_dialogue: A voice that isn't a voice echoes from everywhere and nowhere: "Finally. I've been so... hungry."
boss.victory_text: Neth'arak screams — a sound that threatens to shatter your minds — and then implodes. A blinding flash of white. When your vision clears, you're standing in an empty cave. Sunlight streams through a crack above. It's over.
boss.defeat_text: The darkness closes in. There is no pain. There is nothing at all.

repeatable_bonus.note: The Abyss is the endgame dungeon — repeating it still gives decent rewards
